issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: the problem statement (UML and textual instructions) and the template Main usage expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a String (calls in Main use r.messageOnRide()). The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and the implementing classes Pig and Seal implement messageOnRide(int speed). This parameter-list difference will cause compilation errors or confusion for students following the exercise (they will implement or call messageOnRide() with no arguments while the solution requires an int parameter).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable.messageOnRide signature consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution's Rideable and its implementations (Pig, Seal) to declare and implement public String messageOnRide() (no parameters) and have them return "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" to match the UML and template usage. Alternatively, if the intent is to include speed, update the problem statement UML, textual instructions, and template Main examples to require messageOnRide(int speed) and document how to call it (including the speed argument).
